title: Momenty
description: NIFTY 500 momentum strategy — K-Means clustering across 17 features, Fama-French factor betas, efficient-frontier optimization with Kendall Tau covariance. Live on paper trading. The project that led directly to the IndiQuant internship.

title: Options Pricer
description: C++ CLI engine pricing options via Black-Scholes and Monte Carlo simulation with Delta output and convergence analysis plotted from generated CSV data.

title: VQE — H₂ Benchmark
description: Variational Quantum Eigensolver benchmarking the ground-state energy of molecular hydrogen, landing within ~1% of the exact Hartree value (−1.1077 vs −1.1175 Hartree).

title: Kafka Pipeline
description: Dockerized Kafka producer/consumer system running in KRaft mode — no Zookeeper dependency. Built on WSL with custom Windows hosts file fix.

title: dctect
description: AI image detector using DCT/frequency domain analysis. PASTE_DESCRIPTION.

title: Image → ASCII
description: Converts images into ASCII art via a FastAPI web app, deployed live on Render.

title: Stocky
description: Stock tracking app pulling live market data via yFinance, built on Flask with a SQLite backend.

title: Bare-Metal ESP32
description: Writing directly to GPIO memory-mapped registers in C using a custom cpinmode/cdigitalwrite abstraction — no Arduino layer, no HAL. Includes hardware timer ISR via gptimer and edge-detected button toggle.

title: Mini OS
description: From-scratch OS in C — syscall dispatcher and a CPU scheduler simulating FCFS and Round Robin with Gantt chart verification. In progress.
